confirm.deleteAccount: Delete "{name}" and everything imported for it?
dashboard.title: Your accounts
dashboard.subtitle: Import a Genshin Impact or Honkai: Star Rail account and compare every character with community builds.
dashboard.backendHint: Is the backend running? DEV.md says how to start it; then try again.
dashboard.emptyText: The import guide walks you through it step by step. The quickest way needs only your UID; a full inventory export also finds better artifacts and relics you already own.
dashboard.noBuildsAdmin: No builds downloaded yet. Start the first sync on the {sources} page.
dashboard.noBuildsMember: No builds downloaded yet. They appear once an admin syncs the build sites.
account.fullInventoryHint: Imported from an inventory exporter: suggestions can use every piece you own
account.showcaseOnlyHint: Imported from the in-game Character Showcase by UID
account.showcaseNote: Only showcased characters are known. Upload a full inventory export to analyze every character and get "better piece you already own" suggestions.
account.noBuildsForCharacter: No builds for this character yet.
account.withoutBuilds.one: {count} character has no builds yet; they appear once a build sync has fetched them.
account.withoutBuilds.few: {count} characters have no builds yet; they appear once a build sync has fetched them.
account.withoutBuilds.other: {count} characters have no builds yet; they appear once a build sync has fetched them.
signIn.intro: Import your Genshin Impact and Honkai: Star Rail accounts and see, per character, what to improve. Sign in with your anotoki account to continue.
signIn.noAccess: Your anotoki account {name} has no access to the build analyzer yet. Ask the owner to add you.
signIn.unreachable: The server could not be reached, so signing in is not possible right now. Reload the page to try again.
notSetUp.title: Not set up yet
notSetUp.lead: The build analyzer is installed, but nobody has set it up yet: it does not know its database or how people sign in. Until then there is nothing to show here.
notSetUp.owner: If this is your server, open the setup page, fill in the database and sign-in settings and save them. Then come back here.
notSetUp.notOwner: Not your server? Its owner has to finish the setup. The setup page removes itself once a hosted install is done; if it is gone and this page still shows, upload setup.php again and run it.
